# AI Decision Log: Mode 3 (Full SCVHS)

**Learner:**
**Sprint:** [Number], [Title]
**Date:**
**Spec referenced:** `Spec_S0N_[Title].md`
**AI-generated file(s) reviewed:**

Name this file `AI_Decision_Log_S0N_v1.md`. Never edit it in place; a later pass gets a
new `_v2.md`, `_v3.md`, with a one-line "what changed and why" at the top.

*(Mode 4 learners: use this same template. Mode 4 only changes who drafts the spec;
Validate and this log follow Mode 3 rules exactly.)*

Every construct gets a pass/fail record. Only defective constructs get a full entry;
passing constructs get one line, no essay. No pre-supplied checklist, derive what to
check from your own spec's Constraints and Acceptance Criteria.
